status: source-only correction; implementation preparation; unbuilt and unproved
finding: The prior bare phase proposal is unsound as stated. Rust host assertions, host decoding, IvcState::decider, and Context values that never enter synthesized constraints do not bind the recursive circuit VK to the financial/digest table. A synthesized generic 0->1->2 relation proves only a counter.

source_basis.observation: Host assertions and decider are separate from circuit_transition. The retained circuit binds episode rows because it assigns before0/before1/after1 constants and asserts every assigned state limb equal to the selected row.

format_instance exposes T::format_public_input(state); circuit assigns prev_state through IvcIO, constrains next_state through IvcIO, and invokes circuit_transition. Binding therefore depends on constraints emitted by assign/circuit_transition/constrain_as_public_input, not host-only data.

a_phase_plus_episode_digest.description: Expose phase and a complete-episode context digest, constrain the digest to a fixed constant, and decode state off circuit.
a_phase_plus_episode_digest.assessment: Insufficient unless the circuit also recomputes that digest from all canonical episode fields or proves a checked lookup/opening. Equality to a fixed digest alone binds bytes only by an external correspondence assertion; it does not constrain those bytes or either loan transition. In-circuit SHA256/Poseidon recomputation could repair it but adds a new hash gadget, encoding specification, collision-resistance assumption, and unknown row cost.
a_phase_plus_episode_digest.decision: Do not select for the next smallest experiment.

b_private_full_state_compact_public_bind.description: Keep phase plus all 54 canonical limbs in AssignedState as private constrained values. Expose only phase. For each transition, select the complete pinned before/after rows by phase and assert equality for every private limb; output all selected after limbs and phase+1.
b_private_full_state_compact_public_bind.assessment: Defensible for this finite fixed specialization without an in-circuit hash. Public phase acts as an exact table index because synthesized constraints prove membership in one of three exhaustive constant rows. It is not a general commitment and must not be described as cryptographic commitment.

recommended_representation.state_native: State { phase: u64, financial: [u128;11], digests:[[u64;4];8] } remains complete.
recommended_representation.private_checked_input: 54 limbs: 22 u64 limbs for 11 u128 financial values and 32 u64 limbs for eight 256-bit digests.
synthesized_relation: Range constrain phase and all 54 limbs; phase must be 0 or 1 for an ordinary transition.
For each of 54 before limbs, assign both fixed row0 and row1 constants, select by phase, and assert the private input limb equals the selected constant.
For each of 54 after limbs, select fixed row1 or row2 constant and return it as the private next-state limb.
Return next_phase=phase+1 and constrain only next_phase as application PI.
IvcIO::assign must assign phase and all full limbs; as_public_input/constrain_as_public_input expose only phase. format_public_input returns only phase.
Genesis host state is complete row0; first circuit step constrains its private row0 values. Every recursive successor constrains the prior complete row and produces the complete next row.
recommended_representation.binding_claim: For the fixed three-row episode, the circuit constraints bind phase to every original financial, contract/program/specification, intent, predecessor, output/transition, effects/history, and authority/obligation field. Those constants enter the constraint system and hence the VK. The claim assumes correct constant generation from the pinned episode fixture; it does not prove SHA256 preimages or dynamic semantics.

public_input_inventory.private_breakdown: 1 phase + 22 financial u64 limbs + 32 digest u64 limbs

controls: Reject noncanonical phase values and phase 2 as an ordinary predecessor; constrain phase directly without truncation or modular parsing.
Reject 0->2, 1->0, repeated phase, and any mutation of each low/high financial limb or digest limb because every private limb is equality-constrained to its selected row.
Range constrain every u64 limb below 2^64, preserving unique u128 reconstruction and preventing modular aliases.
Keep fixed row constants in the synthesized circuit; a refactor that leaves them only in host decode/decider is forbidden.
Retain forged-genesis, wrong domain/program/specification/intent/predecessor/output/effects/authority, malformed proof, statement mismatch, and final-accumulator controls.
Hash and record episode.rs, generated source/preimages, harness, Cargo.lock, backend, SRS and resulting VK representation.

exact_source_changes.change: Add phase to complete State/AssignedState; assign all 54 private limbs plus phase; expose only phase in IvcIO PI methods; retain the existing per-limb selected fixed constants and equality constraints; produce selected complete next row plus next phase. Rewrite preflight to assert the one-element PI and retain exhaustive limb mutation rejection.
No semantic change; its exact constants must continue to be referenced inside circuit_transition so they affect the constraint system/VK.
Use a fresh successor manifest/output and bind hashes for the changed harness and unchanged episode. Preserve the reviewed pins and limits.

pins_and_proposed_bound.proposal: one fresh attempt; 480 seconds; k<=17; 8GiB; zero swap; 2 CPUs/jobs; 256MiB retained output; stop at first failure; no automatic retry or k increase

scope_boundaries.recursive: Native proof chain, canonical VK, decider, transcript EOF and accumulator discharge remain separate required executed predicates.
scope_boundaries.ledger: Preview ContractCall statement/effect/VK/version adapter remains unresolved and separate.
